evidence_required: Signed charter: audience; business goal; scope; exclusions; risk class; success metrics
pass_rule: All fields present and no unresolved scope conflict

evidence_required: Keyword set; entity list; intent clusters; source log; freshness dates
pass_rule: Every planned page maps to evidence and a distinct primary intent

gate: Topical map and URL registry frozen
evidence_required: Page registry; hub map; role matrix; cannibalization review
pass_rule: Every indexable URL has one role; parent; canonical intent; and unique promise

evidence_required: About; editorial policy; author/editor profiles; contact; privacy; corrections policy
pass_rule: All pages render; identities are accurate; credentials are not overstated

gate: Design system and template contracts approved
evidence_required: Tokens; components; page-type contract; responsive screenshots
pass_rule: All page types pass desktop; tablet; mobile; dark-mode where supported

evidence_required: Page briefs; final copy; source citations; review status; dates
pass_rule: No placeholder/editorial tokens; every page meets its Definition of Done

evidence_required: Page-to-image manifest; checksums; dimensions; alt; caption; credit; previews
pass_rule: No missing; duplicate; placeholder; wrong-page; crop; or letterbox failures

evidence_required: Automated report for title; meta; canonical; robots; sitemap; H1; schema; OG/X
pass_rule: Zero critical failures; all exceptions documented and approved

evidence_required: Link graph; orphan/dead-end list; edge reasons; hub/tool reciprocity
pass_rule: Zero unexplained broken links; orphans; dead ends; or forced semantic links

evidence_required: Functional tests; accessibility checks; query smoke fixtures; safety tests
pass_rule: All critical workflows and must/must-not search assertions pass

evidence_required: Clean-checkout build log; dependency lock; forbidden-pattern scan; diff scope
pass_rule: Same inputs create equivalent output; no machine-specific paths or missing sources

evidence_required: Secret scan; external-script inventory; forms/privacy review; headers report
pass_rule: No exposed secret; unapproved tracker; insecure endpoint; or privacy blocker

gate: GitHub candidate and Cloudflare preview pass
evidence_required: PR; CI logs; preview URL; screenshot matrix; representative route checks
pass_rule: All checks green; expected diff only; preview approved by owner

gate: Production promotion and live verification pass
evidence_required: Main SHA; Cloudflare deployment ID; HTTPS; live 200s; robots; sitemap; schema; analytics
pass_rule: Live site matches approved candidate and all public checks pass

evidence_required: Previous deployment/SHA; rollback steps; backup/export; incident contact
pass_rule: A tested or dry-run rollback can restore the previous release

evidence_required: Search Console/analytics checks; uptime; issue log; review calendar
pass_rule: Owners and dates are assigned; critical alerts have an action path
